name: comp-28
blurb: Number input with plus and minus buttons on either side.
description: A number field with minus and plus buttons flanking a centered numeric input. Built with React Aria NumberField, supporting arrow keys and button clicks. Defaults to 2048 with minValue of 0.
use_when: Forms needing precise numeric input with visual increment/decrement controls, or where keyboard navigation is essential.
avoid_when: You need custom value constraints beyond minValue or locale-specific formatting.
a11y: Full React Aria support including arrow key navigation. Buttons are semantic. Live region announces value changes.
